welcome.skipHint: Closes this introduction and opens the studio with the current settings
welcome.doneHint: Closes this introduction and opens the studio

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: Every menu, button and message uses this language. You can change it later in Settings.

look.title: How it looks
look.body: Dark is the studio’s own theme. Switch it if you work in daylight.
look.themeHint: Switches the application to the {{name}} theme

craft.title: Your 3D navigation
craft.body: The 3D view mirrors the gestures of the software you already know. You can change it later in the settings.
craft.navigationHint: Uses {{name}} viewport gestures in the 3D view

account.title: A cloud, if you have one
account.body: The studio works without an account, on your own files. A key unlocks generation and the shared library.
account.connected: An account is saved. You can continue.

project.title: Your first project
project.body: A project is a folder on your disk. Create one, open one, or skip and start from Home.
project.createHint: Picks an empty folder and makes it the project
project.openHint: Opens a project folder already on this disk
